title: Checkpoint: adjacency contract
prompt: Implement `int letterDigit(String s)`: count occurrences of a letter immediately followed by a digit. "a1b2" → 2, "a12" → 1 (the '1' after 'a' qualifies; the '2' after '1' does not), "1a" → 0, "" → 0. One pass, compare each character with its successor.

tests.name: letter-digit pairs
tests.hint: Loop i from 0 to s.length() - 2: if isLetter(charAt(i)) && isDigit(charAt(i+1)) count++.
